basics.name: Anthony Aguilar Sanchez
basics.label: Computer Vision / Perception Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software engineer with a systems and full-stack background, including prior experience in the agriculture sector, transitioning into computer vision and perception engineering. Comfortable with the full stack of a perception system: model training (PyTorch, OpenCV, YOLO), embedded/edge deployment (Raspberry Pi, Arduino, ESP32), and sensor-driven applications involving IMU data. Strong foundations in C++, algorithms, and spatial data structures (R-tree), with hands-on experience building IoT and sensor-reporting systems using MQTT pub/sub architectures. Eager to apply and deepen this experience training CV/ML models and fusing LiDAR, GNSS, and IMU data for real-world fruit counting and measurement problems.

work.name: APU Tech
work.summary: Developed mobile and web applications for an agriculture-sector company, including an offline-first field data collection app used to record phytosanitary (crop health) data in areas without internet access.
highlights: Built an offline-first mobile application for field agronomists to collect phytosanitary data in rural areas with no internet access, increasing client acquisition by 20% within 3 months
Integrated the field data-collection app with the company CRM system, reducing manual data entry by 60%
Maintained full-stack web application serving 500+ daily active users with 99.9% uptime

work.name: Balto SAS
work.summary: Architected an event-driven referrals system and internal tools using a microservices/pub-sub backend, building distributed-systems experience relevant to multi-sensor data pipelines.
highlights: Designed and built a referrals system enabling customers to invite others and earn rewards, backed by microservices communicating through a pub/sub event architecture
Designed and developed 10+ internal tools that automated 80% of manual operational tasks
Reduced system response time by 40% through database optimization and caching strategies

work.name: Movistar

highlights: Managed enterprise sales-tracking and fraud-detection application serving 1,000+ daily users with 99.5% uptime

Invited to programming competition in first semester due to outstanding final project in Introduction to Computer Science
Completed coursework in artificial intelligence and software architecture
Participated in multiple hackathons and coding competitions

awards.title: Third Place Winner, Hackathon Movistar

projects.name: IoT Chicken Egg Incubator with Remote Monitoring

Deployed and validated the embedded firmware on Arduino and ESP32 hardware end-to-end

highlights: Configured and maintained services on constrained embedded hardware
Managed system administration, networking, and uptime on an ARM-based single-board computer
